items.head: Federal University of Minas Gerais, Department of Surgery
items.sub: Undergraduate Research Fellow (Iniciação Científica), funded fellowship
items.body: Prospective clinical study evaluating breast sensitivity before and after mastopexy with implants using the mini-L technique. Principal investigator: Leandro Ricardo de Aquino Santos, MD.

items.head: Surgery Research Group
items.body: Design and lead systematic reviews and meta-analyses in general, colorectal, and hepatobiliary surgery, carrying projects from question formulation and PROSPERO registration through search, dual screening, data extraction, and analysis in R. Methods span pairwise, Bayesian, and trial sequential meta-analysis, single-arm pooling of proportions, and synthesis of propensity score matched evidence. Coordinate multi-author teams across institutions, allocate work among junior collaborators, and carry manuscripts through peer review and revision. Mentors: Bernardo Fontel Pompeu, MD, and Sérgio Mazzola Poli de Figueiredo, MD.

items.head: Thoracic Surgery Research Group
items.body: Lead evidence synthesis in thoracic surgery and lung transplantation, serving as primary analyst on most projects. Work includes survival analysis from reconstructed individual patient data in pleural mesothelioma, comparative studies of extracorporeal membrane oxygenation configurations, chest wall reconstruction, and the diagnostic performance of preoperative functional imaging. Collaborate with thoracic surgeons in Brazil, Europe, and the United States. Mentor: Rachid Eduardo Noleto da Nobrega Oliveira, MD.

items.head: Meta-Analysis Academy
items.body: Mentor students through the full research process of systematic reviews and meta-analyses, from question formulation and protocol registration to data extraction, statistical analysis, and manuscript preparation. Provide weekly feedback, ensure methodological rigor, and support mentees toward first authorship. Mentor: Rhanderson Cardoso, MD.
Ran weekly support sessions addressing students' methodological questions and reinforcing research concepts from the week's classes. Mentor: Rhanderson Cardoso, MD.
